fields.description: Weekly issue featuring editorials and local commentary on Dade County school retrenchment and funding, Miami street-light reductions, public health concerns including milk safety and cattle tuberculosis testing, police discipline and court matters (including Miami Beach Judge S. Grover Morrow), tourism versus industrial development debates, Chamber of Commerce finances, Elks activities bringing children to Miami Beach, and a piece advocating support for a Miami aquarium housed in the hull of the Prins Valdemar. Includes society notes, letters to the editor, and advertisements.
